description: Locked test for the CoreRouter v2 pre-registered evaluation (PROTOCOL.md v0, section 4 gate 4). It holds 4,586 fresh RouterArena-twin prompts covering 39 of RouterArena's 40 task_configs, with category quotas proportional to RouterArena's task_config counts (nominal 4,800, at least 25 per category); LiveCodeBench is the one shortfall (0 of 214) because the pinned post-release_v2 LiveCodeBench source is exhausted by earlier twin pools. Every item comes from the same public sources, loaders, item builders, RouterArena prompt templates, licences, overlap screens and collector admission rules as the existing twin pools, and none of its source item ids, normalized question texts, groups (source documents) or rendered prompts appears in any existing twin pool. RouterArena stayed evaluation-only: only its Context, Question and Options columns were read, for the overlap screen. No model was called and no answer was graded to build it; grader readiness was checked with positive, negative and empty controls on the stored references only. The sha256 values pin pool.jsonl (rows with references), records.jsonl (generation inputs) and references.jsonl (grader references). The test will be read exactly once, after the CoreRouter v2 freeze; at most 3 router variants will be compared on it.
read_rule: read exactly once, after the CoreRouter v2 freeze (protocol gate 4)
